# Hair Care Leave-in Conditioner

**Category:** Personal Care

**Type:** Leave-in Conditioner


---

## Brief Description

👑 Lightweight leave-in conditioner for additional hair protection
👑 Suitable for all hair types
👑 Protects hair before heat styling

## Composition and Key Ingredients

▫️ Essential oils of Peppermint, Eucalyptus, Tea Tree, and Spearmint

## Indications

🔹 Hair damaged from coloring, styling, or sun exposure
🔹 Need for extra protection before blow-drying

## Directions for Use

🔹 Spray onto clean, towel-dried hair after shampoo and conditioner
🔹 Do not rinse
🔹 Use before blow-drying or heat styling

## Compatibility with other doTERRA products

🔹 Salon Essentials Protecting Shampoo, Daily Conditioner — previous steps

## Interesting Facts

👑 Ideal lightweight final step for a daily hair care routine

## Cautions

> ⚠️ For external use only. Avoid direct contact with eyes. Discontinue use if skin irritation occurs. Keep out of reach of children.
